newsitem.title: USA: Payless Shoesource Sept same-sales fall.
newsitem.headline: Payless Shoesource Sept same-sales fall.

text.p: Payless ShoeSource Inc said Thursday its same-store sales fell five percent in September.
The retailer said total sales fell to $215.4 million during September from $234.3 million a year ago.
Sales fell because of a planned change in promotional strategy and a shift in reporting periods, it said.
"The reduction by nine days for the 'Buy One, Get Second Pair Half Off' event is consistent with Payless's announced strategy of reducing promotional selling," it said.
During the first eight months of its fiscal year, sales rose to $1.65 billion from $1.62 billion during the same period last year, the company said.
